description: Hierarchical configuration loader shallow-merges section overrides, dropping unmentioned default properties.
spec_notes: ConfigLoader must recursively merge layer overrides while preserving defaults and explicit None values.

tests.test_config_precedence.py:
from loader import ConfigLoader
from config import AppConfig


def test_defaults_preserved():
    loader = ConfigLoader()
    cfg = AppConfig(loader)
    assert cfg.get("server.port") == 8080
    assert cfg.get("server.host") == "0.0.0.0"
    assert cfg.get("database.pool_size") == 10


def test_partial_section_override_preserves_sibling_defaults():
    loader = ConfigLoader()
    # File layer only overrides server.port to 9090
    loader.add_layer({"server": {"port": 9090}})
    cfg = AppConfig(loader)
    assert cfg.get("server.port") == 9090
    assert cfg.get("server.host") == "0.0.0.0"  # Must preserve sibling host
    assert cfg.get("server.workers") == 4        # Must preserve sibling workers


def test_multi_layer_precedence_ordering():
    loader = ConfigLoader()
    # Layer 1: File
    loader.add_layer({"database": {"pool_size": 20, "timeout_ms": 3000}})
    # Layer 2: Env override takes precedence over File
    loader.add_layer({"database": {"pool_size": 50}})
    cfg = AppConfig(loader)
    assert cfg.get("database.pool_size") == 50
    assert cfg.get("database.timeout_ms") == 3000
    assert cfg.get("database.read_only") is False


def test_explicit_none_value_retrieval():
    loader = ConfigLoader()
    loader.add_layer({"custom": {"nullable_flag": None}})
    cfg = AppConfig(loader)
    assert cfg.get("custom.nullable_flag", default="FALLBACK") is None


def test_missing_path_returns_specified_default():
    loader = ConfigLoader()
    cfg = AppConfig(loader)
    assert cfg.get("server.ssl.cert", "default.crt") == "default.crt"
    assert cfg.get("nonexistent.key") is None
